name: Log rotation cleanup
description: Finds .log files older than a cutoff in a folder you name and proposes deleting them. Always previews the exact file list first (dry run) and only deletes after you approve.
approvalPrompt: FRIDAY wants to DELETE {count} old log file(s) ({size}) from “{folder}” older than {olderThanDays} days. This is permanent. Review the previewed list before allowing.
